pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-lobed patches with jagged, high-angularity edges on the neck and shoulder regions. Flank patches exhibit slightly smoother pixel gradients but maintain complex polygonal shapes with varying spatial area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected network of light-colored pathways. Corridor thickness is minimal in the upper shoulder region, expanding in width toward the lower flank. Junction nodes are highly defined with continuous connectivity across the visible lateral surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck, representing a uniform mane structure against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Partial visibility of a dark terminal tail tuft on the posterior-most edge of the left flank.
